claims: ChatGPT runs two separate allowances: one for regular Chat, one shared between Work and Codex
Every heavy task pushed through Codex drains the Work+Codex tank
Routing thinking to Chat (GPT-6 Pro) means it counts against Chat limits, not Codex
Spinning up subagents (research/draft/review) in Chat runs the parallel work on the chat side
Bring only the finished plan into Codex so Codex spends limit executing, not 'thinking out loud'
Difference between 'hitting your limit on Wednesday and getting through the whole week'
how_to_steps: Open regular Chat (not Work) and pick GPT-6 Pro
Give it the big job and tell it to spin up three subagents: Researcher, Drafter, Reviewer; run them in parallel and coordinate
Copy only the finished plan into Codex and have Codex execute inside the project
on_screen_only: Diagram: 'Regular Chat — Chat limit' tank (full) vs 'Work + Codex — Work + Codex limit' tank (draining) with note 'Every heavy task you run in Codex drains this limit'
Project 'GT Compras AI', prompt 'What should we build in GT Compras AI?'

Full prompt: 'Create a simple, one-page comparison of Trello, Asana, and Todoist for a five-person team looking for a free task management tool. Spin up three subagents: 1. Researcher: Check official sources for each tool's free features and limits. 2. Drafter: Prepare the comparison structure, then incorporate the research into a clear draft. 3. Reviewer: Define the evaluation criteria, then check the completed draft for accuracy, missing details, and clarity. Run independent work in parallel and share findings as they become available. Coordinate the agents, fix any issues, and deliver a comparison table, a short recommendation, and source links. Keep it beginner-friendly.'
Model selector 'GPT-6 Astra Extra-high'; 'Full access' toggle
Subagents panel: 'Reviewer — Working for 12s — Sent message to parent — Thinking'

Newsletter landing: 'PracticalyAI — Get 1% Better at AI Every Single Day — One 2-minute email, daily... Join 10,500+ professionals & entrepreneurs. 100% free' and '37.78x better at AI after 365 days of reading'
cta: Subscribe to free daily newsletter practically.ai
